scheme_name: Pension to Widows and Destitute Women
other_conditions: Must be a widow or a destitute woman without a husband, parents, or children
Must be a destitute woman due to desertion or the physical/mental incapacity of her husband (for married women) or parents (for other women)
Must be a permanent resident of Haryana and have resided in the state for at least one year at the time of application
benefits_summary: A pension of ₹2,500 per month is provided to eligible widows and destitute women.
documents_required: Application form in the prescribed format
